notablePrerequisites:
You control nonland permanents that can produce {3}{U}.
Meletis Charlatan does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Meletis Charlatan by paying {2}{U} to copy Dramatic Reversal.
Let the copy resolve, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
